train: What is 18 plus 24? Give the sum as digits.
An exact sum gives both parties a common account of what was combined.
A box holds 36 clips and 9 are removed. Give the number remaining as digits.
Counting what remains keeps availability distinct from the amount originally supplied.
What is 6 multiplied by 8? Give the product as digits.
Multiplication makes the effect of a repeated action visible in a single number.
What is 84 divided by 7? Give the quotient as digits.
Equal division is easy to check once the units and the number of recipients are fixed.
Choose the single word that describes a triangle with three equal sides.
equilateral
A precise category makes clear which property matters for the classification.
Which is heavier, 7 kg or 13 kg? Give the larger amount as digits followed by kg.
13 kg
Comparison depends on a shared unit so that a numerical difference has a stable meaning.
Convert 3 meters to centimeters. Give the value as digits followed by cm.
300 cm
A change of units preserves the physical length while changing how we represent it.
There are five blue tiles. Report the number in a compact JSON object under the key count, as an integer.
{"count":5}
Structured records help different readers interpret one observation consistently.
The shelf label is red. Represent it as a compact JSON object with color set to the lowercase label.
{"color":"red"}
Recording the observed attribute separately helps avoid inferring a category from a label.
A latch was closed at inspection. Represent this as compact JSON with a Boolean value under the key closed.
{"closed":true}
A binary record captures the inspection result while leaving room to record uncertainty elsewhere.
Give a single Python expression that converts the variable n to a string.
str(n)
Converting a value to text changes its representation while preserving what a reader can identify.
Give a single Python expression that finds the number of entries in items.
len(items)
Measuring collection size answers a different question than evaluating the entries themselves.
Give one Python assignment that sets ready to true.
ready = True
An explicit flag makes the state visible instead of leaving readers to infer it.
Pick the earlier day of Tuesday and Friday. Give the day name.
Tuesday
A shared calendar lets people coordinate around the same ordering.
An instruction says to list alpha before beta. Give only those two terms separated by a comma and a space.
alpha, beta
Agreed ordering makes it easier for another person to compare the result with the instruction.
Reverse the letter order in CAT. Use uppercase.
TAC
Reversal preserves the symbols and changes the relation among their positions.
The temperature rose from 8 degrees to 13 degrees. Give the increase as digits.
A change can be tracked independently of the starting level.
The transport card has 30 credits and a trip uses 4. Give the remaining credits as digits.
Distinguishing stock from expenditure makes the remaining commitment visible.
Write the English plural of berry in lowercase.
berries
A shared spelling rule makes the shift from one example to many easy to read.
Choose the lowercase word for the material in 'glass bottle'.
glass
Separating an object's material from its use helps different people classify it for different purposes.
test: A row has 31 places and 14 are filled. How many remain? Use digits for the value.
What is seven times nine? Use digits for the value.
A parcel weighs 4 kg. Give the mass in grams, with digits followed by g.
Give the earlier month of August and March. Use the month name.
The room has 11 windows. Encode the count using a JSON object under the key windows, as an integer.
The pump is disabled. Encode this as JSON with a Boolean key named enabled.
Write a Python expression that converts the string variable text into an integer.
Write one Python assignment setting the variable attempts to the number zero.
